28 Sep 2024
Quirimbas Belt — Phase II propagation complete

Field crew logged 4,212 Rhizophora mucronata seedlings transplanted across plots Q7–Q11 on the northern lagoon edge. Survivorship at 30 days holds at 91.4%, ahead of the 84% target.

Project: Quirimbas · Your contribution: $4,750 · open project file →

19 Sep 2024
Wairoa — riparian fencing finished, 6.2 km

Stock exclusion fencing along the Otoi tributary closed two months ahead of schedule. Native flax (Phormium tenax) plantings begin 14 October with the Ngāti Pāhauwera nursery.

Project: Wairoa · Your contribution: $3,300 · open project file →

04 Sep 2024
Cyclone Yagi appeal — funds deployed within 72 hrs

Your $500 emergency contribution joined 412 donors to underwrite a $94,200 disbursement to the Bến Tre delta repair crew. Equipment manifest and receipts posted in the impact ledger.

Appeal closed · Total raised $94,200 · view disbursement →

21 Aug 2024
Tłı̨chǫ — caribou collar telemetry online

Sixteen GPS collars deployed across the Bathurst herd. First three months of movement data will inform the winter range protection proposal submitted to GNWT in February.
